Databases and SQL: from records to reliable changes

Teach in the numbered order. Activities 01-04 establish the Year 11 pathway; 05 introduces grouped reports with a labelled Year 12 HAVING extension. Complete relevant practice and feedback before any assessment. This is a progression, not a claim to cover every SQL syllabus item.

Open student.pdf offline, or use the published page for textbook links and selected-activity printing. No specialist equipment is required; each activity explains a paper route. Files are synthetic classroom data. SQLite: open practice.sqlite directly OR run setup.sql once in a fresh database; do not run setup over an existing copy. Back up a disposable copy before Activity 06. Python: use a school-approved Python 3 editor. No software or hardware is controlled by these pages.

Student ZIP excludes teacher answers. Public teacher materials are separately downloadable. Content CC BY 4.0; original code MIT. Textbook: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/
